principle: The 19 existing templates remain the only production layouts. This mapping reclassifies each template as a bounded layout primitive and assigns semantic Visual Roles; it does not add templates.

mappings.best_when: IMAGE-01 must establish exact product identity without marketing copy.
mappings.reference_learning: All six references separate a neutral official main image from the persuasion sequence.
boundaries: No text, badge, scene or inferred accessory

mappings.best_when: One value proposition must be understood before details.
mappings.reference_learning: Eufy and Plaud show that a calm hero can establish fit or workflow value without a feature collage.

mappings.primitive: Centered product with top message and limited callouts
mappings.best_when: A visible part or interaction is the single visual center.
mappings.reference_learning: Soundcore product cutaways and Eufy mechanism units work when the object stays central and callouts are limited.

mappings.best_when: One feature needs a short benefit and one optional source-backed note.
mappings.reference_learning: Levoit and Eufy repeatedly pair one visible mechanism with one shopper consequence.

mappings.primitive: Full-bleed scene with controlled product and overlay zones
mappings.best_when: A believable Japanese-life moment answers a concrete purchase question.
mappings.reference_learning: Plaud, Levoit and Eufy use scenes as fit evidence and rhythm resets, not decoration.

mappings.primitive: Object or diagram plus stacked proof zone
mappings.best_when: An invisible mechanism or performance claim needs a source-linked explanation.
mappings.reference_learning: Soundcore and Eufy are strongest when one mechanism resolves one performance question; ECOVACS shows the density limit.
boundaries: Every claim has source and condition

mappings.primitive: Centered hub with verified relationship map
mappings.best_when: Compatibility and control relationships are a purchase decision.
mappings.reference_learning: Plaud workflow maps and Eufy control closure are useful only when relationships stay explicit and limited.

mappings.primitive: Selection headline plus bounded comparison matrix
mappings.best_when: A small number of source-backed criteria will change the shopper's choice.
mappings.reference_learning: All six references use comparison, but Soundcore and Plaud show that full tables are often too dense for Gallery.
boundaries: Do not force a full desktop table into mobile

mappings.primitive: Product anchor plus stacked purchase checks
mappings.best_when: Included items, installation, support, privacy or compatibility can block purchase.
mappings.reference_learning: Eufy closes with support, privacy and ecosystem; Levoit closes with household fit.

mappings.primitive: Wide opening split with one visual center
mappings.best_when: A+ must reframe the category and value without replaying Gallery.
mappings.reference_learning: Plaud and Levoit use the A+ opening to reset the experience around workflow or audience, not a feature list.

mappings.best_when: One mechanism-to-benefit explanation needs more room than Gallery.
mappings.reference_learning: Eufy keeps mechanism explanations readable by giving one question a complete horizontal unit.
boundaries: Stack text then image on mobile

mappings.primitive: Two or three equal semantic cards
mappings.best_when: Two or three parallel items answer the same consumer question.
mappings.reference_learning: Plaud input modes and Eufy three-reason explanations work because cards are parallel; ECOVACS inventories are not.
boundaries: Exactly two or three parallel cards

mappings.best_when: The page needs to prove fit, routine or relief in a believable context.
mappings.reference_learning: Levoit uses a dark bedroom as a rhythm change; Plaud uses work scenes to prove workflow fit.

mappings.primitive: Large technical visual plus proof column
mappings.best_when: The shopper needs mechanism, condition and consequence together.
mappings.reference_learning: Soundcore demonstrates credibility; ECOVACS demonstrates why density must be capped.

mappings.best_when: Setup effort or accessory sequence is a purchase barrier.
mappings.reference_learning: Eufy's fit-first story shows installation information is confidence content, not a technical afterthought.
boundaries: No inferred accessory or omitted prerequisite

mappings.primitive: System relationship map with editable labels
mappings.best_when: The product's value depends on verified devices, apps or platforms working together.
mappings.reference_learning: Plaud's workflow chapters and Eufy's control closure show that relationship maps must follow the user's task.
boundaries: Spokes convert to vertical relationships on mobile

mappings.best_when: The user must choose among current variants or understand a method difference.
mappings.reference_learning: Comparison works as closure across all references but becomes exhausting when every row is treated equally.

mappings.best_when: Compatibility, requirements or conditions remain after the story.
mappings.reference_learning: Soundcore's FAQ converts a dense technical story into final purchase clarity.

mappings.primitive: Brand statement plus official product or scene
mappings.best_when: An approved brand promise materially reduces purchase risk.
mappings.reference_learning: Competitor Brand Stories often overuse awards; SwitchBot should use brand only when it supports the product decision.
boundaries: No unsupported leadership or award claim
